Chooses between lightmaps and vertex lighting for a level. Vertex lighting is faster on some graphics cards but looks worse.
@param bsp           The level.
@param use_lightmaps  True for lightmaps, False for vertex lighting. Defaults to True.
@gap There are no lightmaps. The call is accepted and the level always uses its vertex colors.
